name: 🐞 Bug report
description: Report a defect in the VVAH pipeline (S0-S11), CLI, remediation/validation, or a backend
title: [Bug]:

attributes.value:
Thanks for the report. **Please do not include sensitive, personal, or confidential data** — including scan findings output or source from scanned repositories. Share **error output only**.

Please report security vulnerabilities by emailing the security team at: **`vvaharness@visa.com`**. 
For coordinated disclosure and additional reporting channels, see: 
- Visa Vulnerability Disclosure Program: https://usa.visa.com/about-visa/vulnerability-disclosure.html
Please do **not** report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

attributes.label: Affected pipeline stage
attributes.description: Which stage is impacted? Choose cross-cutting if this spans CLI/config/backend behavior.

attributes.label: Model(s) used
attributes.description: The exact model(s) for the run — copy from the run's run_manifest.json (it records the models/config/timing) or your config models: block. List per-role models if they differ. Enter n/a if not applicable.

attributes.label: OS, Python version, and install method
Exact command line
attributes.description: Paste the exact vvaharness command you ran (redact paths if needed).

attributes.label: What happened?
attributes.description: Clear description of the bug and what you expected instead. Please keep under ~1,500 characters.

attributes.label: Steps to reproduce
attributes.description: Numbered steps to reproduce. Please keep under ~1,500 characters.

attributes.label: Relevant error output
attributes.description: Error messages / stack traces only — please keep under ~2,000 characters (trim long traces to the first and last frames). Include vvaharness doctor output when relevant. Do NOT paste scan findings, source code from scanned repos, or credentials.
